title: The Day I Became a Team Leader
script: Narrator: [excited] Last month, my manager called me into her office, and I thought I was in trouble because that almost never happens.
Narrator: [laughing softly] Instead, she told me I was going to become the new team leader for the marketing group. I was so surprised that I forgot to say thank you.
Narrator: [thoughtful] I had worked at that company for three years, but I never expected a promotion so soon, especially because two coworkers had been there longer than me.
Narrator: [honestly] When I told my colleagues, some of them were happy for me, but I could feel that others felt a little strange about it.
Narrator: [nervous] My first week as a leader was harder than I expected, because I had to give tasks to people who used to be my equals.
Narrator: [reflective] One coworker, Budi, seemed distant at first. He barely spoke to me during meetings, although we used to eat lunch together every day.
Narrator: [gently] So one afternoon, I asked him directly if something was wrong. He admitted that he had wanted the position too, and he needed some time to accept it.
Narrator: [warmly] I told him I understood, and that his experience was actually going to help the whole team, not just me.
Narrator: [with relief] After that conversation, things slowly improved between us, because we finally spoke honestly instead of avoiding each other.
Narrator: [thoughtful] I learned that leadership isn't about being liked immediately. It's about listening carefully, even when a conversation feels uncomfortable.
Narrator: [determined] Now, when I plan our weekly meetings, I always ask for everyone's opinion before I decide anything important.
Narrator: [warmly] Budi and I have lunch together again, and he recently helped me train a new employee, which meant a lot to me.
Narrator: [reflective] I still make mistakes as a leader, but I try to fix them quickly instead of pretending they didn't happen.
Narrator: [with a small smile] If someone had told me a year ago that I would lead this team, I probably wouldn't have believed them.
Narrator: [warmly] But here I am, and although it's difficult sometimes, I'm proud of how far I've come since that nervous day in my manager's office.

quiz.question: Why did the narrator think she was in trouble at first?
options: She had made a big mistake
Her manager rarely called her into the office
quiz.explanation: She says her manager almost never calls her in, so she assumed something was wrong.

quiz.question: How did Budi behave toward the narrator during her first week?
options: He seemed distant and barely spoke to her
He asked for a promotion too
quiz.explanation: Budi seemed distant at first, even though they used to eat lunch together.

quiz.question: What did Budi admit when the narrator asked him directly?
options: He had wanted the position too and needed time to accept it
He was moving to another city
quiz.explanation: Budi admitted he had wanted the leadership position and needed time to accept the change.

quiz.question: What does the narrator now do before deciding anything important in meetings?
options: She asks for everyone's opinion first
quiz.explanation: She now asks for everyone's opinion before making important decisions.

quiz.question: What has Budi recently helped the narrator do?
quiz.explanation: Budi recently helped her train a new employee, which meant a lot to her.
